title: Rabbi Yehudah the Baker
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He lived in Rabbi Akiva’s generation, as Hyman argues from [Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Rosh_Hashanah.1.5.4): “Rabbi Yehudah the Baker said (in [Rosh Hashanah 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.22a.1) it reads Rabbi Yehudah without further designation): Heaven forbid! Rabbi Akiva was not excommunicated; rather, the head of Gader was, and Rabban Gamliel sent and removed him from his headship.” In [Bava Batra 132a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.132a.4): “Rabbi Yehudah the Baker said: An incident with my sister’s daughter, a bride,” etc. ([Rashbam](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashbam_on_Bava_Batra.132a.4.1) explains that his son married his sister’s daughter.) He is likewise mentioned in [Menachot 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.6b.20): “Rabbi Yose ben Yose ben Yasyan and Rabbi Yehudah the Baker said: When is this said? When he took the handful,” etc. In [Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Chagigah.2.1.10), and [Kohelet Rabbah 7:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Kohelet_Rabbah.7.8.1) [it is related] that he was one of those executed by the government, and Elisha ben Avuyah saw his tongue in a dog’s mouth and said: “This is Torah, and this is its reward?”

He is likewise mentioned in Eichah Rabbah, chapter 2, on “He swallowed,” and Midrash Tehillim 9:13 (compare [Midrash Tehillim 9](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tehillim.9.14)): Ben Kufya wished to save him, and it was decreed that he too be killed.[^1]

notes.text: The Yerushalmi says Akiva was never excommunicated. In the Bavli, Yehudah says Akiva did not detain the witnesses. Hyman names Ben Kufya in the rescue; the consulted Midrash Tehillim names Bar Kappara. [Yalkut Shimoni on Psalms](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.643.9) tells the rescue story with Ben Kufya. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1639&lang=en) also gives Ben Kufya and reports different versions of the sight that Elisha saw.
